decisions.reason: The existing unscoped K700902 claim conflicts with the repair text, which names Moog K750744 or GM 23377014, and the current catalog pass does not confirm K700902 for every declared application.
The existing unscoped 235-1078 claim is not one of the article-prescribed ACDelco 213-3521 or Delphi SS11378 options, and current catalog evidence does not establish complete application coverage.

The thermostat repair is conditional on scan-data diagnosis, while the existing THRGM-0002 card is unconditional, unscoped, and not confirmed across the article's engine applications by the current catalog pass.
The unscoped 471-1021 compressor claim does not prove complete year, engine, refrigerant-system, or catastrophic-failure application coverage, and the current catalog pass cannot confirm it.
The unscoped WPGM-700 water-pump claim is not confirmed across all declared Terrain years and engine applications by the current catalog evidence, so it cannot remain a blanket public buy link.
The article requires the applicable V8 pump, but the existing WPGM-609V claim has no enforceable engine scope and current catalog evidence does not prove it for every declared application.

The repair centers on broken bolts and conditionally required manifold or gaskets; the unscoped MS19936 gasket-set card is not a universal repair and current catalog evidence does not establish complete 5.3L/6.2L coverage.
